hooks.command: if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec rtk hook claude; fi
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec graphify hook-guard search; fi
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec graphify hook-guard read; fi
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec graphify hook-guard compact; fi
if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
